comments.author: @rickolivier8782
comments.text: Mostly a well done video.  However, there were a few mispronunciations that the production team should have easily avoided.  For me the worst part was that scenery shots supposedly picturing NH locations were obviously NOT New Hampshire at all.  It appeared to show locations around the world including Switzerland and numerous shots that looked very much like many locations in the Alps. would rate it as a weak % out of ten.
